jobs.title: Production Technician II (Robotics)
jobs.description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity

Ensuring the operational readiness of our robots by performing in-house maintenance and repairs in time is the core of this technical role. You will have a direct impact on customer success by performing diagnostics and hardware repairs on ANYmal robots and their components. You will take on full responsibilities ranging from electrical and mechanical assemblies to testing complete robots. You will collaborate with various teams and contribute to the improvement of our maintenance and manufacturing processes. We are looking for an independent and motivated Robotics Technician (Polymechanic / Electronics or Automation Technician) to join our team, which focuses on maintaining customer robots as well as our internal fleet, and supporting the prototype and series production of new robots at our production site in the city of Zurich.

The Market & Our Technology

ANYbotics transforms the industrial sector by introducing robotics to a wide range of novel applications that so far were beyond reach (see our case studies in Chemicals , Oil & Gas , Railways , Wind Energy , Mining , Construction ). Our customers are large asset operators and service providers of industrial plants pioneering robotics technology for inspection and maintenance. Our solution enables autonomous routine inspections and monitoring of large-scale industrial facilities for increased safety and productivity. We develop numerous customized hardware systems, including the entire robotic platform, actuators, sensors, inspection payloads, charging systems, and software to achieve world-class mobility, autonomy, and inspection capabilities, often based on AI. We have proven the technology and the business impact on our customers in long-term pilot projects. We are now scaling the commercialization of our solution(s) and deploying directly into operation at customer facilities worldwide.

Your Contributions

• Maintenance, diagnostic and repair of customer robots and our internal fleet

• Troubleshooting electromechanical products and prototypes to identify and fix technical issues

• Conducting tests and quality control of components and robots, including commissioning

• Manufacturing and assembly of modules and robots for prototypes and 0-Series production

• Documenting non-conformances and contributing to corrective and preventive actions

• Contributing to the further development of our manufacturing, assembly, and test procedures

• Supporting the continuous improvement of the technical equipment and infrastructure

Your Profile

• Apprenticeship as a Polymechanic or Automation Technician EFZ

• 3 years + work experience in the field of mechatronics or equipment manufacturing

• Good practical knowledge in the assembly of electromechanical components

• Understanding of technical drawings and work instructions

• Experience with measuring tools, testing equipment and ESD standards

• Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, multicultural environment

• Good general computer skills (preferably Google Workspace)

• Very good German and English skills (Level B2)

Bonus Points

• Experience in production, repair and troubleshooting of electronic assemblies

• Driving license CH-Cat. B

We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.

Agency Policy: We are not currently partnering with external search firms or recruitment agencies. Any profiles or resumes submitted to ANYbotics employees without a prior written agreement will be considered public disclosure and the property of ANYbotics, involving no liability or fee for subsequent hiring.

Il mercato e la nostra tecnologia

ANYbotics trasforma il settore industriale introducendo la robotica ad una vasta gamma di applicazioni innovative che finora erano al di là della portata (vedi i nostri studi di casi in Chimica, Oil & Gas , Ferrovie , Energia eolica, Mining , Costruzione ). Sviluppiamo numerosi sistemi hardware personalizzati, tra cui l'intera piattaforma robotica, attuatori, sensori, carichi di ispezione, sistemi di ricarica e software per raggiungere capacità di mobilità, autonomia e ispezione di livello mondiale, spesso basate su AI. Abbiamo dimostrato la tecnologia e l'impatto aziendale sui nostri clienti in progetti pilota a lungo termine. Stiamo ora scalando la commercializzazione della nostra soluzione (s) e dispiegando direttamente in funzione presso le strutture clienti in tutto il mondo.

I tuoi contributi

• Manutenzione, diagnostica e riparazione dei robot del cliente e della nostra flotta interna

• Risoluzione dei problemi dei prodotti elettromeccanici e dei prototipi per identificare e risolvere i problemi tecnici

• Condurre test e controllo qualità di componenti e robot, tra cui messa in servizio

• Produzione e montaggio di moduli e robot per prototipi e produzione 0-Series

• Documentazione di non conformità e contribuire a azioni correttive e preventive

• Contribuire all'ulteriore sviluppo delle nostre procedure di produzione, assemblaggio e test

• Sostenere il continuo miglioramento delle attrezzature tecniche e delle infrastrutture

Il tuo profilo

• Apprendistato come Polymechanic o Automation Technician EFZ

• 3 anni + esperienza di lavoro nel campo della meccatronica o della produzione di attrezzature

• Buona conoscenza pratica nel montaggio di componenti elettromeccanici

• Comprensione di disegni tecnici e istruzioni di lavoro

• Esperienza con strumenti di misura, apparecchiature di prova e standard ESD

• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente in un ambiente multiculturale veloce

• Buone competenze informatiche generali (preferibilmente Google Workspace)

• Molto buone competenze in tedesco e inglese (Level B2)

Punti bonus

• Esperienza nella produzione, riparazione e risoluzione dei problemi dei gruppi elettronici

• Patente di guida CH-Cat. B

Vi offriamo un ambiente di lavoro molto emozionante e dinamico, l'opportunità di entrare a far parte di una società in rapida crescita e di un team ambizioso che è in missione di cambiare il mercato dell'ispezione industriale, la possibilità di sfruttare la vostra esperienza e portare le vostre idee, un salario di mercato equo, un attraente piano di azionariato dei dipendenti e un lavoro nella città di Zurigo.

Sie arbeiten mit verschiedenen Teams zusammen und tragen zur Verbesserung unserer Wartungs- und Fertigungsprozesse bei. Der Markt & unsere Technologie

ANYbotics transformiert den Industriesektor durch die Einführung von Robotik in ein breites Spektrum neuartiger Anwendungen, die bisher unerreichbar waren (siehe unsere Fallstudien in Chemicals, Oil & Gas, Railways, Wind Energy, Mining, Construction). Unsere Kunden sind Großanlagenbetreiber und Dienstleister von Industrieanlagen, die wegweisende Robotik-Technologie für Inspektion und Wartung betreiben. Wir entwickeln zahlreiche maßgeschneiderte Hardwaresysteme, einschließlich der gesamten Roboterplattform, Aktoren, Sensoren, Inspektionsnutzlasten, Ladesysteme und Software, um erstklassige Mobilitäts-, Autonomie- und Inspektionsfähigkeiten zu erreichen, die oft auf KI basieren. Wir haben die Technologie und die geschäftlichen Auswirkungen auf unsere Kunden in langfristigen Pilotprojekten unter Beweis gestellt. Wir skalieren jetzt die Kommerzialisierung unserer Lösung(en) und werden direkt in Kundenbetrieben weltweit eingesetzt.

Ihre Beiträge

• Wartung, Diagnose und Reparatur von Kundenrobotern und unserer internen Flotte

• Fehlerbehebung elektromechanischer Produkte und Prototypen zur Identifizierung und Behebung technischer Probleme

• Durchführung von Tests und Qualitätskontrolle von Komponenten und Robotern, einschließlich Inbetriebnahme

• Herstellung und Montage von Modulen und Robotern für Prototypen und 0-Serien-Produktion

• Dokumentation von Nichtkonformitäten und Beitrag zu Korrektur- und Vorbeugungsmaßnahmen

• Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung unserer Fertigungs-, Montage- und Testverfahren

• Unterstützung der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der technischen Ausstattung und Infrastruktur

Ihr Profil

• Lehrling als Polymechaniker oder Automatisierungstechniker EFZ

• 3 Jahre + Berufserfahrung im Bereich Mechatronik oder Anlagenbau

• Gute praktische Kenntnisse in der Montage elektromechanischer Bauteile

• Verständnis von technischen Zeichnungen und Arbeitsanweisungen

• Erfahrung mit Messgeräten, Prüfgeräten und ESD-Standards

• Fähigkeit, unabhängig in einem schnelllebigen, multikulturellen Umfeld zu arbeiten

• Gute allgemeine Computerkenntnisse (vorzugsweise Google Workspace)

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (Level B2)

Bonuspunkte

• Erfahrung in Produktion, Reparatur und Fehlerbehebung von elektronischen Baugruppen

• Führerschein CH-Cat. B

Wir bieten Ihnen ein sehr spannendes und dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld, die Möglichkeit, Teil eines schnell wachsenden Unternehmens zu werden, und ein ambitioniertes Team, das den Markt für Industrieinspektionen verändern möchte, die Möglichkeit, Ihre Erfahrungen zu nutzen und eigene Ideen einzubringen, ein faires Marktgehalt, einen attraktiven Mitarbeiteraktienplan und einen Job in der Stadt Zürich.

Agenturpolitik: Wir arbeiten derzeit nicht mit externen Suchfirmen oder Rekrutierungsagenturen zusammen. Alle Profile oder Lebensläufe, die an ANYbotics-Mitarbeiter ohne vorherige schriftliche Vereinbarung eingereicht werden, gelten als öffentliche Offenlegung und als Eigentum von ANYbotics, ohne Haftung oder Gebühr für die spätere Einstellung.

jobs.description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity

As the Engineering Manager - Product Compliance, you will own the compliance strategy and execution for ANYmal X, our Ex-proof legged robot designed for hazardous areas, as it moves into series production and global rollout. Right now, this means preparing for our 2027 market demand by securing ATEX/IECEx, CE, radio, and electrical safety approvals across all launch markets, while navigating the transition to the new Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, the EU Battery Regulation, and the Cyber Resilience Act. You will work most closely with our R&D engineering teams, notified bodies, and test labs to embed compliance directly into our product development life cycle. This is a unique chance to build scalable compliance processes from the ground up, rather than inheriting bureaucracy, for a product actively used in the world's most demanding oil, gas, and chemical facilities.

The Market & Our Technology

ANYbotics is shaping the future of industrial automation with advanced legged robots that operate in the most demanding and hazardous environments. Our cutting-edge technology performs autonomous inspections in sectors like oil and gas, energy, and chemicals, keeping humans out of harm's way while ensuring facility integrity. ANYmal X is at the forefront of this innovation, bringing explosion-proof robotics into series production. We operate in a highly regulated, rapidly evolving market where rigorous compliance—spanning machinery, radio, battery, explosion protection, and cybersecurity—is not just a legal requirement, but a core competitive advantage that enables our global expansion.

Your Impact

• Own the product compliance team backlog, priorities, and reviews while dedicating roughly half your time to hands-on deliverables like technical files and risk assessments

• Ensure ANYmal X is compliant for series production by updating the EU DoC to the Machinery Regulation and maintaining all ATEX/IECEx, radio, and EMC approvals

• Deliver non-EU market access according to the 2027 commercial plan, driving certification projects for the US (FCC, NRTL) and priority Middle East markets

• Embed compliance into product development by establishing clear R&D gate checklists and standardizing technical file structures for all new products and major changes

• Conduct gap analyses and drive execution plans to meet the EU Battery Regulation (EU 2023/1542) and Cyber Resilience Act (EN 18031) requirements

Your Profile

• Hands-on experience independently writing CE technical files, risk assessments (ISO 12100), and EU Declarations of Conformity for complex electromechanical or electronic products

• Proven track record of running end-to-end certification projects with test labs and notified bodies, including test planning, witness testing, and closing nonconformities

• Ability to independently read and apply harmonized standards and confidently defend technical positions with R&D engineers and certifiers

• Experience leading a small team or project group while continuing to execute a large share of the hands-on technical work

• Fluency in English and availability to work on-site in a hybrid capacity at our Zurich office

Bonus points:

• Experience with ATEX/IECEx equipment certification (Ex d, Ex p, Ex i) and ISO/IEC 80079-34 QMS

• Knowledge of lithium-ion battery compliance (IEC 62133-2, UN 38.3, EU Battery Regulation)

• Experience securing non-EU market access such as FCC, OSHA NRTL/UL, UKCA, ISED, or Middle East country approvals

• Familiarity with robotics and functional safety standards, including ISO 10218, ISO 13482, ISO 13849, IEC 61508, or ISO 25785-1

• Hands-on experience with cybersecurity compliance for connected products (EN 18031, CRA)

• Proficiency in German

We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.

As the Engineering Manager - Product Compliance, you will own the compliance strategy and execution for ANYmal X, our Ex-proof legged robot designed for hazardous areas, as it moves into series production and global rollout. The Market & Our Technology

ANYbotics is shaping the future of industrial automation with advanced legged robots that operate in the most demanding and hazardous environments. Our cutting-edge technology performs autonomous inspections in sectors like oil and gas, energy, and chemicals, keeping humans out of harm's way while ensuring facility integrity. ANYmal X is at the forefront of this innovation, bringing explosion-proof robotics into series production. We operate in a highly regulated, rapidly evolving market where rigorous compliance—spanning machinery, radio, battery, explosion protection, and cybersecurity—is not just a legal requirement, but a core competitive advantage that enables our global expansion.

Your Impact

• Own the product compliance team backlog, priorities, and reviews while dedicating roughly half your time to hands-on deliverables like technical files and risk assessments

• Ensure ANYmal X is compliant for series production by updating the EU DoC to the Machinery Regulation and maintaining all ATEX/IECEx, radio, and EMC approvals

• Embed compliance into product development by establishing clear R&D gate checklists and standardizing technical file structures for all new products and major changes

• Conduct gap analyses and drive execution plans to meet the EU Battery Regulation (EU 2023/1542) and Cyber Resilience Act (EN 18031) requirements

Your Profile

• Hands-on experience independently writing CE technical files, risk assessments (ISO 12100), and EU Declarations of Conformity for complex electromechanical or electronic products

• Proven track record of running end-to-end certification projects with test labs and notified bodies, including test planning, witness testing, and closing nonconformities

• Experience leading a small team or project group while continuing to execute a large share of the hands-on technical work

• Knowledge of lithium-ion battery compliance (IEC 62133-2, UN 38.3, EU Battery Regulation)

jobs.description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced and meticulous PCB Layout Designer / ECAD Engineer to join our Hardware Engineering team. In this role, you will take technical ownership of the layout process for our high-complexity Printed Circuit Board Assemblies (PCBAs), directly impacting the performance and reliability of our autonomous mobile robots (ANYmal). You will serve as the bridge between schematic concepts and robust, manufacturable hardware. Beyond layout execution, you will play a strategic role in owning our electronics component library and spearheading our transition to a new, professional ECAD tool. This position gives our electrical engineers the freedom to focus on schematics while you optimize our physical design pipeline for scale.

The Market & Our Technology

ANYbotics is revolutionizing industrial inspection with ANYmal, our quadrupedal robot designed to navigate the world’s most challenging environments—from offshore oil platforms to complex chemical plants. Our technology integrates advanced robotics software with robust hardware that must withstand extreme conditions, strict EMI/EMC standards, and rigorous safety certifications. By developing highly sophisticated, reliable, and optimized electronics, you enable our robots to operate autonomously where humans cannot.

Your Impact

• Own and manage the entire PCB layout design lifecycle for complex multi-layer boards across our active product lines

• Take full ownership and management of the ANYbotics electronics component library (InvenTree), ensuring high-quality metadata, symbols, and footprints

• Lead the evaluation, introduction, and migration execution to a new, industry-standard ECAD tool

• Conduct rigorous layout reviews for internal electrical engineers and external engineering contractors to maintain impeccable design standards

• Implement and update corporate EDRC design guidelines for layout routing, stack-ups, and constraints

• Partner closely with mechanical engineers and Electronic Manufacturing Services (EMS) partners to optimize Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) for serial and prototype production

Your Profile

• Degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or a related technical field with at least 5 years of hands-on experience in electronics design and layout for industrial applications

• Expert-level proficiency in at least one industry-standard ECAD software tool (e.g., Altium, KiCad, Cadence)

• Proven track record of successfully designing complex multi-layer PCBs with strict functional safety and EMI/EMC compliance requirements

• Deep technical knowledge of signal integrity, high-speed routing, controlled impedance, length matching, and return path optimization

• Extensive experience navigating DFM/DFA constraints and collaborating directly with EMS partners for hardware productization

• Dedicated mindset toward component creation, database cleanliness, and rigorous library management

• Proactive, highly accountable professional who takes clear technical decisions and thrives in a fast-paced environment

Bonus Points

• Experience with rigid-flex PCB designs or layout techniques for wireless technologies

• Background or strong interest in Explosion-proof (Ex-protection) electronics design for hazardous environments

• Past participation in a company-wide ECAD tool or library migration project

• Background in electronics for aerospace, military, or highly ruggedized industrial equipment

We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.

• Professionista attivo e altamente responsabile che prende chiare decisioni tecniche e prospera in un ambiente veloce

Punti bonus

• Sfondo o forte interesse per la progettazione elettronica a prova di esplosione (Ex-protection) per ambienti pericolosi

• Partecipazione passata a un progetto ECAD o di migrazione della biblioteca

• Sfondo in elettronica per attrezzature industriali aerospaziali, militari o altamente robuste

Vi offriamo un ambiente di lavoro molto emozionante e dinamico, l'opportunità di entrare a far parte di una società in rapida crescita e di un team ambizioso che è in missione di cambiare il mercato dell'ispezione industriale, la possibilità di sfruttare la vostra esperienza e portare le vostre idee, un salario di mercato equo, un attraente piano di azionariato dei dipendenti e un lavoro nella città di Zurigo.

descriptionByLocale.en:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced and meticulous PCB Layout Designer / ECAD Engineer to join our Hardware Engineering team. In this role, you will take technical ownership of the layout process for our high-complexity Printed Circuit Board Assemblies (PCBAs), directly impacting the performance and reliability of our autonomous mobile robots (ANYmal). You will serve as the bridge between schematic concepts and robust, manufacturable hardware. Beyond layout execution, you will play a strategic role in owning our electronics component library and spearheading our transition to a new, professional ECAD tool. This position gives our electrical engineers the freedom to focus on schematics while you optimize our physical design pipeline for scale.

The Market & Our Technology

ANYbotics is revolutionizing industrial inspection with ANYmal, our quadrupedal robot designed to navigate the world’s most challenging environments—from offshore oil platforms to complex chemical plants. Our technology integrates advanced robotics software with robust hardware that must withstand extreme conditions, strict EMI/EMC standards, and rigorous safety certifications. By developing highly sophisticated, reliable, and optimized electronics, you enable our robots to operate autonomously where humans cannot.

Your Impact

• Own and manage the entire PCB layout design lifecycle for complex multi-layer boards across our active product lines

• Take full ownership and management of the ANYbotics electronics component library (InvenTree), ensuring high-quality metadata, symbols, and footprints

• Lead the evaluation, introduction, and migration execution to a new, industry-standard ECAD tool

• Conduct rigorous layout reviews for internal electrical engineers and external engineering contractors to maintain impeccable design standards

• Implement and update corporate EDRC design guidelines for layout routing, stack-ups, and constraints

• Partner closely with mechanical engineers and Electronic Manufacturing Services (EMS) partners to optimize Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) for serial and prototype production

Your Profile

• Degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or a related technical field with at least 5 years of hands-on experience in electronics design and layout for industrial applications

• Expert-level proficiency in at least one industry-standard ECAD software tool (e.g., Altium, KiCad, Cadence)

• Proven track record of successfully designing complex multi-layer PCBs with strict functional safety and EMI/EMC compliance requirements

• Deep technical knowledge of signal integrity, high-speed routing, controlled impedance, length matching, and return path optimization

• Extensive experience navigating DFM/DFA constraints and collaborating directly with EMS partners for hardware productization

• Dedicated mindset toward component creation, database cleanliness, and rigorous library management

• Proactive, highly accountable professional who takes clear technical decisions and thrives in a fast-paced environment

Bonus Points

• Experience with rigid-flex PCB designs or layout techniques for wireless technologies

• Background or strong interest in Explosion-proof (Ex-protection) electronics design for hazardous environments

• Past participation in a company-wide ECAD tool or library migration project

• Background in electronics for aerospace, military, or highly ruggedized industrial equipment

We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.

Agency Policy: We are not currently partnering with external search firms or recruitment agencies. Any profiles or resumes submitted to ANYbotics employees without a prior written agreement will be considered public disclosure and the property of ANYbotics, involving no liability or fee for subsequent hiring.
descriptionByLocale.de:
ANYbotics ist ein schnell wachsendes Technologieunternehmen, das sich der Gestaltung der Zukunft der mobilen Robotik in verschiedenen Branchen verschrieben hat. Schließen Sie sich unserem hochtalentierten und motivierten Team von mehr als 200 Mitarbeitern an und arbeiten Sie an modernster Robotertechnologie.

Die Chance

Wir suchen einen erfahrenen und sorgfältigen PCB Layout Designer / ECAD Engineer, der unserem Hardware Engineering Team beitritt. In dieser Funktion übernehmen Sie die technische Verantwortung für den Layoutprozess unserer hochkomplexen Leiterplattenbaugruppen (PCBAs), was sich direkt auf die Leistung und Zuverlässigkeit unserer autonomen mobilen Roboter (ANYmal) auswirkt. Sie werden als Brücke zwischen schematischen Konzepten und robuster, herstellbarer Hardware dienen. Über die Ausführung des Layouts hinaus spielen Sie eine strategische Rolle beim Besitz unserer Elektronikkomponentenbibliothek und bei der Einführung eines neuen, professionellen ECAD-Tools. Diese Position gibt unseren Elektroingenieuren die Freiheit, sich auf Schaltpläne zu konzentrieren, während Sie unsere physische Design-Pipeline für die Skalierung optimieren.

Der Markt & unsere Technologie

ANYbotics revolutioniert die industrielle Inspektion mit ANYmal, unserem vierfüßigen Roboter, der entwickelt wurde, um die anspruchsvollsten Umgebungen der Welt zu navigieren - von Offshore-Ölplattformen bis hin zu komplexen Chemieanlagen. Unsere Technologie integriert fortschrittliche Robotik-Software mit robuster Hardware, die extremen Bedingungen, strengen EMI/EMV-Standards und strengen Sicherheitszertifizierungen standhalten muss. Durch die Entwicklung hochentwickelter, zuverlässiger und optimierter Elektronik ermöglichen Sie unseren Robotern, autonom zu arbeiten, wo Menschen es nicht können.

Ihre Wirkung

• Besitzen und verwalten Sie den gesamten PCB-Layout-Design-Lebenszyklus für komplexe Multilayer-Platten in unseren aktiven Produktlinien

• Übernahme und Verwaltung der ANYbotics Electronic Component Library (InvenTree) und Sicherstellung hochwertiger Metadaten, Symbole und Footprints

• Führen Sie die Evaluierung, Einführung und Migrationsausführung zu einem neuen, branchenüblichen ECAD-Tool

• Führen Sie strenge Layout-Überprüfungen für interne Elektroingenieure und externe Engineering-Auftragnehmer durch, um einwandfreie Design-Standards einzuhalten

• Implementieren und Aktualisieren von EDRC-Designrichtlinien für Layout-Routing, Stack-ups und Einschränkungen

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Maschinenbauingenieuren und Partnern von Electronic Manufacturing Services (EMS) zur Optimierung von Design for Manufacturing (DFM) und Design for Assembly (DFA) für die Serien- und Prototypenproduktion

Ihr Profil

• Abschluss in Elektrotechnik oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich mit mindestens 5 Jahren praktischer Erfahrung in Elektronikdesign und -layout für industrielle Anwendungen

• Kenntnisse auf Expertenebene in mindestens einem branchenüblichen ECAD-Software-Tool (z. B. Altium, KiCad, Cadence)

• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der erfolgreichen Entwicklung komplexer Mehrschicht-PCBs mit strengen Anforderungen an die funktionale Sicherheit und die EMI/EMV-Konformität

• Tiefes technisches Wissen über Signalintegrität, Hochgeschwindigkeits-Routing, kontrollierte Impedanz, Längenanpassung und Rückwegoptimierung

• Umfangreiche Erfahrung beim Navigieren von DFM/DFA-Einschränkungen und der direkten Zusammenarbeit mit EMS-Partnern für die Hardware-Produktivierung

• Engagierte Denkweise in Bezug auf Komponentenerstellung, Datenbankreinheit und strenges Bibliotheksmanagement

• Proaktiver, verantwortungsbewusster Fachmann, der klare technische Entscheidungen trifft und in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung gedeiht

Bonuspunkte

• Erfahrung mit starren Flex-PCB-Designs oder Layout-Techniken für drahtlose Technologien

• Hintergrund oder starkes Interesse an explosionssicherem (Ex-Schutz) Elektronikdesign für gefährliche Umgebungen

• Vergangene Teilnahme an einem unternehmensweiten ECAD-Tool oder Bibliotheksmigrationsprojekt

• Hintergrund in der Elektronik für Luft- und Raumfahrt, Militär oder stark robuste Industrieausrüstung

Wir bieten Ihnen ein sehr spannendes und dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld, die Möglichkeit, Teil eines schnell wachsenden Unternehmens zu werden, und ein ambitioniertes Team, das den Markt für Industrieinspektionen verändern möchte, eine Chance, Ihre Erfahrungen zu nutzen und eigene Ideen einzubringen, ein faires Marktgehalt, einen attraktiven Mitarbeiteraktienplan und einen Job in der Stadt Zürich.

Agenturpolitik: Wir arbeiten derzeit nicht mit externen Suchfirmen oder Rekrutierungsagenturen zusammen. Alle Profile oder Lebensläufe, die an ANYbotics-Mitarbeiter ohne vorherige schriftliche Vereinbarung eingereicht werden, gelten als öffentliche Offenlegung und als Eigentum von ANYbotics, ohne Haftung oder Gebühr für die spätere Einstellung.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Anybotics est une société technologique en croissance rapide dédiée à façonner l'avenir de la robotique mobile dans plusieurs industries. Rejoignez notre équipe hautement talentueuse et motivée de plus de 200 personnes et travaillez sur la technologie robot de pointe.

L'opportunité

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un concepteur de PCB / ingénieur ECAD expérimenté et méticuleux pour rejoindre notre équipe d'ingénierie matérielle. Dans ce rôle, vous prendrez la responsabilité technique du processus de mise en page de nos assemblages de circuits imprimés (PCBAs) à haute complexité, qui ont une incidence directe sur les performances et la fiabilité de nos robots mobiles autonomes (ANYmal). Vous servirez de pont entre les concepts schématiques et le matériel robuste et manufacturier. Au-delà de l'exécution de la mise en page, vous jouerez un rôle stratégique dans la propriété de notre bibliothèque de composants électroniques et dirigerez notre transition vers un nouvel outil ECAD professionnel. Cette position donne à nos ingénieurs électriques la liberté de se concentrer sur les schémas tout en optimisant notre pipeline de conception physique pour l'échelle.

Le marché et notre technologie

Anybotics révolutionne l'inspection industrielle avec Anymal, notre robot quadrupède conçu pour naviguer dans les environnements les plus difficiles du monde – des plates-formes pétrolières offshore aux usines chimiques complexes. Notre technologie intègre des logiciels robotiques avancés avec du matériel robuste qui doit résister à des conditions extrêmes, des normes strictes EMI/EMC et des certifications de sécurité rigoureuses. En développant une électronique hautement sophistiquée, fiable et optimisée, vous permet à nos robots d'opérer de manière autonome là où les humains ne peuvent pas.

Votre impact

• Propre et gérer l'ensemble du cycle de vie de conception de la disposition des PCB pour des panneaux multicouches complexes dans nos gammes de produits actives

• Prendre pleinement en charge et gérer la bibliothèque des composants électroniques d'Anybotics (InvenTree), en assurant la qualité des métadonnées, des symboles et des empreintes

• Diriger l'évaluation, l'introduction et l'exécution de la migration vers un nouvel outil ECAD standard pour l'industrie

• Procéder à des examens rigoureux de la configuration des ingénieurs en électricité internes et des entrepreneurs en génie externe pour maintenir des normes de conception impeccables

• Mettre en œuvre et mettre à jour les lignes directrices de conception de l'EDRC pour l'acheminement de la disposition, les empilements et les contraintes

• Partenaire en étroite collaboration avec les ingénieurs en mécanique et les partenaires des Services de fabrication électronique (SEM) pour optimiser la conception pour la fabrication (DFM) et la conception pour l'assemblage (DFA) pour la production de série et de prototype

Votre profil

• Diplôme en ingénierie électrique/électronique ou dans un domaine technique connexe avec au moins 5 ans d'expérience pratique dans la conception et la mise en page électroniques pour les applications industrielles

• Compétence de niveau expert dans au moins un outil logiciel ECAD standard de l'industrie (p. ex. Altium, KiCad, Cadence)

• Expérience éprouvée de la conception de PCB multicouches complexes avec une sécurité fonctionnelle stricte et des exigences de conformité EMI/EMC

• Connaissance technique approfondie de l'intégrité du signal, du routage à grande vitesse, de l'impédance contrôlée, de l'adéquation de la longueur et de l'optimisation du chemin de retour

• Expérience approfondie de navigation des contraintes DFM/DFA et collaboration directe avec les partenaires du SME pour la production de matériel

• Un esprit dédié à la création de composants, à la propreté des bases de données et à une gestion rigoureuse des bibliothèques

• Professionnel proactif et hautement responsable qui prend des décisions techniques claires et prospère dans un environnement rapide

Points bonus

• Expérience des conceptions de PCB rigides ou des techniques de mise en page pour les technologies sans fil

• Contexte ou fort intérêt pour la conception électronique anti-explosion (ex-protection) pour les environnements dangereux

• Participation passée à un projet d'outil ECAD ou de migration de bibliothèques à l'échelle de l'entreprise

• Contexte de l'électronique pour les équipements industriels aérospatiaux, militaires ou très robustes

Nous vous offrons un environnement de travail très excitant et dynamique, l'opportunité de faire partie d'une entreprise en croissance rapide et d'une équipe ambitieuse qui est en mission de changer le marché de l'inspection industrielle, une chance de tirer parti de votre expérience et d'apporter vos propres idées, un salaire équitable du marché, un plan attrayant d'actionnariat salarié, et un emploi dans la ville de Zurich.

Politique de l'Agence : Nous ne sommes pas en partenariat avec des entreprises de recherche externes ou des agences de recrutement. Tous les profils ou curriculum vitae soumis à des employés d'Anybotics sans accord écrit préalable seront considérés comme une divulgation publique et la propriété d'Anybotics, ce qui n'implique aucune responsabilité ni aucun droit pour l'embauche ultérieure.

jobs.title: Marketing Intern - Events & Community
jobs.description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 190 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology. We are open to internships all year round and post regularly.

We’re always looking for passionate, curious, and motivated interns to join our mission.

This is your chance to collaborate with world-class experts, gain real-world experience, and make meaningful contributions in a fast-paced, interdisciplinary environment.

The Opportunity

As our Marketing Intern for Events & Community, you will gain hands-on experience in how a B2B deep-tech company turns marketing initiatives into real-world pipeline. Working closely with our Marketing Campaign & Operations Specialist and the wider Growth team, you will learn how to coordinate industry events, support our social channels, and assist in managing branded touchpoints. This internship is designed to give you deep insights into campaigns, events, social media, and CRM in a fast-paced environment, providing you with a strong foundation for your future career in marketing while you support real projects under the guidance of experienced professionals.

The Market & Our Technology

ANYbotics builds the autonomous workforce for the global process industry. Founded in 2016 as an ETH Zurich spin-off, we design, manufacture and operate ANYmal, a legged robot for industrial inspection, together with the Data Navigator industrial AI platform. Our robots work at more than 250 industrial sites for 50+ customers across five continents, in oil and gas, chemicals, power, metals and other process industries. About 200 people from around 30 nationalities work at our headquarters in Zurich and our offices in San Francisco and Barcelona.

Your Impact

• Support the coordination of trade shows and customer events by assisting with logistics, booth materials, and on-site setup under the guidance of our event leads

• Learn to process event leads into our CRM effectively so Sales can follow up, and help gather event results to support future planning

• Contribute to ANYbotics' voice in the industrial and robotics community by helping to draft content and support our weekly social calendar

• Assist in transforming articles, case studies, and webinars into engaging social posts that highlight the people and robots behind ANYbotics

• Help map our existing content by industry and buyer stage to identify gaps, and participate in testing email journeys to keep our CRM data clean

• Monitor competitors, press coverage, and industry awards to help keep the marketing team informed

• Support the sourcing and inventory management of branded materials and merchandise, learning how to balance cost and quality

• Collaborate on producing the newsletter, refreshing website pages, and organizing a centralized, self-serve library of digital marketing assets

• Explore and help implement AI agents and automated workflows that assist the team with event reporting and content drafts

• Review marketing tools and processes alongside the team, helping to document best practices so the whole department can use them

Your Profile

• Currently enrolled in, or recently graduated from, a Bachelor's or Master's program in marketing, communications, business, or a related field

• Eligible for an internship in Switzerland

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to help track multiple tasks, deadlines, and suppliers without dropping any

• Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, comfortable learning new tasks and adapting to changing priorities

• Proactive mindset with a desire to learn, take feedback constructively, and support cross-functional projects

• Strong collaborative skills, eager to work closely with various teams within the Commercial division

• Fluent written and spoken English

• Hands-on attitude and willingness to travel to events, including assisting with the physical setup and carrying of booth materials

Bonus Points

• Experience with LinkedIn and other social platforms, ideally in a professional or academic setting

• Familiarity with HubSpot, Notion, Canva, or similar tools

• Enthusiasm for experimenting with modern AI marketing tools

• Interest in robotics, AI, or industrial technology

Internship Details:

Start date: any time of the year and always on the 1st of the month

Duration: 6 months

Workload: 100% (Full time, Onsite)

Who can apply:

EU applicants for internships

The internship can be voluntary

A work permit is not required but the candidate needs a residence permit

Must be enrolled in a University

Non-EU applicants for internships:

Internship must be mandatory (supported by a letter from a university)

A work permit is required

Must reside in CH

Interested? Submit your application

We will contact you if your skills and experience are a good fit for the team and the role. Please note due to the high load of applications we will only contact those that are relevant. Thank you for your understanding.

What We Offer:

- Hands-on experience working on advanced locomotion software.

- Mentorship from industry experts.

- Opportunities to contribute to innovative projects.

- A dynamic and collaborative work environment.

- Potential for future full-time opportunities.

We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive and fun environment in the city of Zurich.

descriptionByLocale.it:
ANYbotics è una società tecnologica in rapida crescita dedicata a modellare il futuro della robotica mobile in più settori. Unisciti al nostro team altamente talentuoso e motivato di oltre 190 persone e lavorare sulla tecnologia robot all'avanguardia. Siamo aperti agli stage tutto l'anno e post regolarmente.

Questa è la tua occasione per collaborare con esperti di livello mondiale, acquisire esperienza nel mondo reale, e dare contributi significativi in un ambiente veloce e interdisciplinare.

L'opportunità

Come nostro Marketing Intern per Eventi e Comunità, si acquisirà esperienza pratica in come una società B2B deep-tech trasforma iniziative di marketing in pipeline di mondo reale. Lavorando a stretto contatto con il nostro Marketing Campaign & Operations Specialist e il team di crescita più ampio, imparerai come coordinare gli eventi del settore, sostenere i nostri canali sociali, e assistere nella gestione dei touchpoint di marca. Questo stage è progettato per darvi approfondimenti in campagne, eventi, social media e CRM in un ambiente veloce, fornendo una solida base per la vostra futura carriera nel marketing, mentre supporti progetti reali sotto la guida di professionisti esperti.

Il mercato e la nostra tecnologia

ANYbotics costruisce la forza lavoro autonoma per l'industria del processo globale. Fondato nel 2016 come spin-off ETH Zurich, progettiamo, produciamo e gestiamo QUALSIASI, un robot legged per l'ispezione industriale, insieme alla piattaforma AI industriale Data Navigator. I nostri robot lavorano in più di 250 siti industriali per 50+ clienti in cinque continenti, in petrolio e gas, prodotti chimici, energia, metalli e altre industrie di processo. Circa 200 persone provenienti da circa 30 nazionalità lavorano presso la nostra sede a Zurigo e i nostri uffici a San Francisco e Barcellona.

Il tuo impatto

• Sostenere il coordinamento delle fiere e degli eventi dei clienti aiutando con la logistica, i materiali dello stand e l'allestimento in loco sotto la guida del nostro evento

• Imparare a elaborare eventi porta nel nostro CRM in modo efficace in modo che le vendite possono seguire, e aiutare a raccogliere i risultati degli eventi per sostenere la pianificazione futura

• Assistere nella trasformazione di articoli, case study e webinar in messaggi sociali coinvolgenti che evidenziano le persone e i robot dietro ANYbotics

• Aiuta a mappare i nostri contenuti esistenti per settore e fase acquirente per identificare lacune, e partecipare a test viaggi e-mail per mantenere puliti i nostri dati CRM

• Monitorare i concorrenti, la copertura della stampa e i premi del settore per aiutare a mantenere informato il team di marketing

• Sostenere la gestione di approvvigionamento e inventario di materiali e merce di marca, imparando come bilanciare i costi e la qualità

• Collaborare alla produzione della newsletter, aggiornando le pagine del sito web e organizzando una libreria centralizzata e self-serve di attività di marketing digitale

• Esplora e aiuta a implementare agenti AI e flussi di lavoro automatizzati che aiutano il team con report degli eventi e progetti di contenuto

• Verificare gli strumenti e i processi di marketing insieme al team, aiutando a documentare le migliori pratiche in modo che l'intero dipartimento possa utilizzarli

Il tuo profilo

• Attualmente iscritta, o recentemente laureata, un programma di Bachelor o Master in marketing, comunicazioni, business o un campo relativo

• Eleggibile per uno stage in Svizzera

• Forte capacità organizzative con la capacità di aiutare a monitorare più compiti, scadenze e fornitori senza cadere qualsiasi

• Prove capacità di prosperare in un ambiente veloce e dinamico, apprendimento confortevole nuovi compiti e adattarsi alle priorità in evoluzione

• Mindset proattivo con il desiderio di imparare, prendere feedback costruttivamente e sostenere progetti cross-funzionali

• Forti competenze collaborative, desiderosi di lavorare a stretto contatto con varie squadre all'interno della divisione commerciale

• Fluente scritto e parlato inglese

• L'atteggiamento di mano e la volontà di viaggiare agli eventi, compreso l'assistenza con la configurazione fisica e il trasporto di materiali di cabina

Punti bonus

• Esperienza con LinkedIn e altre piattaforme sociali, idealmente in un ambiente professionale o accademico

• Familiarità con HubSpot, Nozione, Canva, o strumenti simili

• Enthusiasm per sperimentare i moderni strumenti di marketing AI

• Interessi della robotica, dell'intelligenza artificiale o della tecnologia industriale

Dettagli di stage:

Data di inizio: in qualsiasi momento dell'anno e sempre al 1° del mese

Durata: 6 mesi

Carico di lavoro: 100% (Full time, Onsite)

Chi può applicare:

Candidati UE per stage

Lo stage può essere volontario

Un permesso di lavoro non è richiesto, ma il candidato ha bisogno di un permesso di soggiorno

Deve essere iscritto a un'università

Candidati non UE per stage:

Il tirocinio deve essere obbligatorio (supportato da una lettera di un'università)

È richiesto un permesso di lavoro

Deve risiedere in CH

Interessante? Invia la tua richiesta

Vi contatteremo se le vostre competenze e la vostra esperienza sono una buona misura per il team e il ruolo. Si prega di notare a causa dell'elevato carico di applicazioni che contatteremo solo quelli che sono rilevanti. Grazie per la vostra comprensione.

Cosa offriamo:

- Esperienza pratica che lavora sul software avanzato di locomozione.

- Mentorialità da esperti del settore.

- Opportunità di contribuire a progetti innovativi.

- Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e collaborativo.

- Potenziale per future opportunità a tempo pieno.

Vi offriamo un ambiente di lavoro molto emozionante e dinamico, l'opportunità di entrare a far parte di una società in rapida crescita e di un team ambizioso che è in missione di cambiare il mercato dell'ispezione industriale, la possibilità di sfruttare la vostra esperienza e portare le vostre idee, uno stipendio di mercato equo, un ambiente attraente e divertente nella città di Zurigo.

The Market & Our Technology

Our robots work at more than 250 industrial sites for 50+ customers across five continents, in oil and gas, chemicals, power, metals and other process industries. About 200 people from around 30 nationalities work at our headquarters in Zurich and our offices in San Francisco and Barcelona.

Your Impact

• Learn to process event leads into our CRM effectively so Sales can follow up, and help gather event results to support future planning

• Contribute to ANYbotics' voice in the industrial and robotics community by helping to draft content and support our weekly social calendar

• Assist in transforming articles, case studies, and webinars into engaging social posts that highlight the people and robots behind ANYbotics

• Help map our existing content by industry and buyer stage to identify gaps, and participate in testing email journeys to keep our CRM data clean

• Monitor competitors, press coverage, and industry awards to help keep the marketing team informed

• Support the sourcing and inventory management of branded materials and merchandise, learning how to balance cost and quality

• Collaborate on producing the newsletter, refreshing website pages, and organizing a centralized, self-serve library of digital marketing assets

• Explore and help implement AI agents and automated workflows that assist the team with event reporting and content drafts

• Review marketing tools and processes alongside the team, helping to document best practices so the whole department can use them

Your Profile

• Currently enrolled in, or recently graduated from, a Bachelor's or Master's program in marketing, communications, business, or a related field

• Eligible for an internship in Switzerland

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to help track multiple tasks, deadlines, and suppliers without dropping any

• Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, comfortable learning new tasks and adapting to changing priorities

• Proactive mindset with a desire to learn, take feedback constructively, and support cross-functional projects

• Strong collaborative skills, eager to work closely with various teams within the Commercial division

• Fluent written and spoken English

• Hands-on attitude and willingness to travel to events, including assisting with the physical setup and carrying of booth materials

Bonus Points

• Experience with LinkedIn and other social platforms, ideally in a professional or academic setting

• Familiarity with HubSpot, Notion, Canva, or similar tools

• Enthusiasm for experimenting with modern AI marketing tools

• Interest in robotics, AI, or industrial technology

Internship Details:

Start date: any time of the year and always on the 1st of the month

Duration: 6 months

Workload: 100% (Full time, Onsite)

EU applicants for internships

The internship can be voluntary

A work permit is not required but the candidate needs a residence permit

Must be enrolled in a University

Non-EU applicants for internships:

Internship must be mandatory (supported by a letter from a university)

A work permit is required

Must reside in CH

Interested? Submit your application

We will contact you if your skills and experience are a good fit for the team and the role. Please note due to the high load of applications we will only contact those that are relevant. Thank you for your understanding.

- Mentorship from industry experts.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity

Are you a self-driven engineer who thrives on the shop floor? We are looking for a pragmatic, structured, and hands-on Manufacturing Engineer to join our Production and Maintenance Team in the heart of Zurich.

In this role, you work in the value stream, taking responsibility for our daily manufacturing operations. You provide first-level support and diagnose technical issues to maintain throughput and testing uptime. Your scope includes the maintenance of our current robot generation and driving the NPI execution on the shop floor, specifically the build and troubleshooting of prototypes and zero-series units.

You act as the interface between Industrialisation, Quality, R&D, Supply Chain, and Logistics, while collaborating with our EMS partner to ensure stable series production. If you have an "on-hands" mentality and want to implement KPIs to resolve bottlenecks in a high-tech scale-up, this is your next challenge.

The Market & Our Technology

ANYbotics transforms the industrial sector by introducing robotics to a wide range of novel applications that so far were beyond reach (see our case studies in Chemicals, Oil & Gas, Railways, Wind Energy, Mining, Construction). Our customers are large asset operators and service providers of industrial plants pioneering robotics technology f or inspection and maintenance. Our solution enables autonomous routine inspections and monitoring of large-scale industrial facilities for increased safety and productivity . We develop numerous customized hardware systems, including the entire robotic platform, actuators, sensors, inspection payloads, charging systems, and software to achieve world-class mobility, autonomy, and inspection capabilities, often based on AI. We have proven the t echnology and the business impact on our customers in long-term pilot projects. We are now scaling the commercialization of our solution(s) and deploying directly into operation at customer facilities worldwide.

Your Impact

• Provide first-level technical support to ensure efficient production flow and minimize downtime

• Document Non-Conformities (NCRs), perform root cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventive actions

• Take ownership of the maintenance, calibration, and improvement of production tooling and test equipment

• Monitor First Pass Yield (FPY) and throughput times consistently to proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks

• Lead projects and initiatives to optimize output, efficiency, and on-time delivery

• Drive the optimization of the end-to-end value stream for pilot series production and maintenance operations

• Execute New Product Introduction (NPI) and the implementation of Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) on the shop floor

• Ensure test procedures and work instructions are technically accurate and up to date

Your Profile

• Bachelor’s degree or technical diploma (HF/FH) in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or Mechatronics

• 3 years+ experience in a high-tech manufacturing or robotics environment

• Strong troubleshooting ability with a self-driven proactive and structured mindset

• Experience with test instruments, oscilloscopes, DMMs, and power supplies

• Proven hands-on skills in soldering, crimping, and cable assembly

• Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, multicultural environment

• Excellent technical communication and presentation skills

• Fluency in German and English (Level B2 minimum)

Bonus Points

• Knowledge of lean manufacturing or Six Sigma methodologies

• Experience with test data analysis or yield monitoring tools

• Familiarity with firmware update and validation workflows

• Driving license CH-Cat. B

We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.

Agency Policy: We are not currently partnering with external search firms or recruitment agencies. Any profiles or resumes submitted to ANYbotics employees without a prior written agreement will be considered public disclosure and the property of ANYbotics, involving no liability or fee for subsequent hiring.

• Prove abilità pratiche in saldatura, crimping e montaggio via cavo

• Patente di guida CH-Cat. jobs.description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly driven, strategic Key Account Manager to lead our expansion within the Oil, Gas, and Chemical industries. In this pivotal role, you will be at the forefront of category creation—introducing groundbreaking robotic inspection and maintenance solutions to offshore and onshore operations.

You will not just be managing accounts; you will be architecting multi-year strategic partnerships, navigating complex enterprise hierarchies, and driving the adoption of autonomous technologies. If you have a relentless builder mindset, deep sector knowledge in O&G, and the executive presence to influence C-level decision-makers, you will play a crucial role in scaling our commercial success and transforming industrial plant operations.

The Market & Our Technology

ANYbotics transforms industrial plants in the energy, process, and utility sectors by introducing robotics to applications that were previously out of reach. Our customers—large asset operators and industrial service providers—are pioneering the use of robotics for autonomous routine inspections, driving increased safety, productivity, and reduced OPEX. We develop the entire robotic platform, including actuators, sensors, inspection payloads, charging systems, and the AI-driven software that enables world-class mobility and inspection insights. With proven technology and validated business impact, we are scaling up our commercial operations globally.

Your Contributions

•
 Drive Aggressive Growth : Independently manage and execute the end-to-end sales funnel to sell and operationally deploy 30-50+ robotics units into key accounts by 2027

•
 Master Enterprise Penetration : Build and execute multi-year strategic account plans. Map, access, and influence multi-layered industrial organizations (Operations, Reliability, Digital, HSE, Procurement, C-Level) to build internal champions

•
 Consultative Value Selling : Translate complex robotics autonomy and inspection data into measurable business outcomes (OPEX reduction, safety, emissions, workforce optimization) and align our solutions with clients' long-term strategic objectives

•
 Secure Long-Term Partnerships : Negotiate complex contract terms, pricing, and framework agreements, finding win-win solutions that allow for sustainable scaling

•
 Cross-Functional Orchestration : Influence without authority by coordinating internal teams (Product, Engineering, Deployment, Customer Success) to shape solutions that meet customer needs and ensure 100% retention

•
 Commercial Rigor : Maintain strict CRM pipeline hygiene and data quality, delivering a high forecasting discipline (±10% accuracy) with zero surprises to leadership

• Market Intelligence : Analyze the competitive landscape and industry trends, feeding actionable insights back to the business to influence our product roadmap

Your Profile

•
 Experience : Proven, recent track record in direct sales and Key Account Management of complex, high-tech industrial solutions (ideally software-enabled hardware/robotics) within the Oil & Gas and Chemical industries

•
 Industry Expertise: Deep understanding of the O&G ecosystem, including operators, service companies, and EPC contractors

•
 Exceptional knowledge of IOC, Large Chemical Companies, DACH procurement structures, vendor registration processes, and NOC governance models is highly preferred

•
 Category Creation Mindset: A relentless, go-getter mentality with the resilience to navigate ambiguity, create demand where budgets may not yet exist, and persist through long industrial sales cycles

•
 Executive Presence: The gravitas to confidently engage senior stakeholders and autonomously resolve commercial or operational tensions in a composed, solution-oriented manner

•
 Technical Aptitude : Strong ability to position robotics within broader industrial automation and digital transformation ecosystems (DCS, asset integrity, IIoT platforms)

•
 Sales Discipline: Expertise in using state-of-the-art CRM systems to drive objective pipeline management and accurate forecasting

•
 Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; highly adaptable to cultural differences in global enterprise accounts

•
 Education: University degree (Bachelor’s or Master’s) in engineering, business, marketing, or a related field

We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary and an attractive employee stock ownership plan.

descriptionByLocale.it:
ANYbotics è una società tecnologica in rapida crescita che modella il futuro della robotica mobile in più industrie. Unisciti al nostro team di talento e motivato di oltre 200 persone e lavorare sulla tecnologia robot all'avanguardia.

L'opportunità

Stiamo cercando un Key Account Manager altamente guidato e strategico per condurre la nostra espansione all'interno delle industrie Oil, Gas e Chimica. In questo ruolo fondamentale, sarete in prima linea nella creazione di una categoria, introducendo soluzioni di ispezione e manutenzione robotiche innovative per operazioni offshore e onshore.

Non sarà solo la gestione dei conti; sarà l'archiviazione di partenariati strategici pluriennali, la navigazione di complesse gerarchie aziendali e la guida dell'adozione di tecnologie autonome. Se si dispone di una mentalità di costruttore instancabile, profonda conoscenza del settore in O&G, e la presenza esecutiva per influenzare i decisori di livello C, si giocherà un ruolo cruciale nella scalare il nostro successo commerciale e trasformare le operazioni di impianti industriali.

Il mercato e la nostra tecnologia

ANYbotics trasforma gli impianti industriali nei settori dell'energia, del processo e dell'utilità introducendo la robotica a applicazioni che in precedenza erano fuori portata. I nostri clienti, grandi operatori di asset e fornitori di servizi industriali, sono pionieri nell'uso della robotica per ispezioni di routine autonome, guidando maggiore sicurezza, produttività e ridotto OPEX. Sviluppiamo l'intera piattaforma robotica, inclusi attuatori, sensori, carichi di ispezione, sistemi di ricarica, e il software AI-driven che consente intuizioni di mobilità e ispezione di livello mondiale. Con la tecnologia collaudata e l'impatto aziendale convalidato, stiamo scalando le nostre operazioni commerciali a livello globale.

I tuoi contributi

•
Drive Aggressive Growth: gestire e eseguire in modo indipendente l'imbuto di vendita end-to-end per vendere e distribuire in modo operativo 30-50+ unità robotiche in account chiave entro il 2027

•
Master Enterprise Penetration: Costruire ed eseguire piani di account strategici pluriennali. Mappa, accesso e influenza organizzazioni industriali multistrato (Operazioni, Affidabilità, Digitale, HSE, Procurement, C-Level) per costruire campioni interni

•
Consultative Value Selling: Traduci l'autonomia robotica complessa e i dati di ispezione in risultati aziendali misurabili (riduzione, sicurezza, emissioni, ottimizzazione della forza lavoro) e allinea le nostre soluzioni con gli obiettivi strategici a lungo termine dei clienti

•
Partenariati a lungo termine sicuri: negoziare termini contrattuali complessi, prezzi e accordi quadro, trovare soluzioni win-win che consentono una scalata sostenibile

•
Orchestrazione Cross-Functional: Influenza senza autorità coordinando i team interni (Product, Engineering, Deployment, Customer Success) per modellare le soluzioni che soddisfano le esigenze del cliente e garantire la conservazione del 100%

•
Rigor commerciale: Mantenere l'igiene e la qualità dei dati del gasdotto CRM rigorosi, offrendo una disciplina di previsione elevata (±10% di precisione) con zero sorprese alla leadership

• Market Intelligence: Analizzare le tendenze del paesaggio competitivo e dell'industria, alimentando intuizioni attuabili di nuovo al business per influenzare la nostra roadmap del prodotto

Il tuo profilo

•
Esperienza: comprovata, recente track record nelle vendite dirette e Key Account Management di soluzioni industriali complesse e ad alta tecnologia (hardware/robotici abilitati al software) all'interno delle industrie Oil & Gas e Chemical

•
Competenza dell'industria: profonda comprensione dell'ecosistema O&G, compresi gli operatori, le società di servizi e gli appaltatori EPC

•
Conoscenza eccezionale di IOC, grandi aziende chimiche, strutture di approvvigionamento DACH, processi di registrazione dei fornitori e modelli di governance NOC è altamente preferito

•
Mindset di creazione di categoria: Una mentalità implacabile, go-getter con la resilienza per navigare in ambiguità, creare domanda dove i bilanci non possono ancora esistere, e persistere attraverso lunghi cicli di vendita industriale

•
Presenza esecutiva: La gravità per coinvolgere con fiducia gli stakeholder senior e risolvere autonomamente le tensioni commerciali o operative in modo composto e orientato alla soluzione

•
Capacità di posizionare la robotica all'interno di sistemi di automazione industriale più ampi e di trasformazione digitale (DCS, integrità degli asset, piattaforme IIoT)

•
Disciplina di vendita: Competenza nell'utilizzo di sistemi CRM all'avanguardia per la gestione delle pipeline oggettive e la previsione accurata

•
Comunicazione: Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale in inglese; altamente adattabile alle differenze culturali nei conti aziendali globali

•
Istruzione: laurea (Bachelor o Master) in ingegneria, business, marketing, o un campo relativo

Vi offriamo un ambiente di lavoro molto emozionante e dinamico, l'opportunità di entrare a far parte di una società in rapida crescita e di un team ambizioso che è in missione di cambiare il mercato di ispezione industriale, la possibilità di sfruttare la vostra esperienza e portare le vostre idee, uno stipendio di mercato equo e un attraente piano di azionariato dei dipendenti.

ANYbotics transformiert Industrieanlagen im Energie-, Prozess- und Versorgungssektor durch die Einführung von Robotik in Anwendungen, die zuvor unerreichbar waren. Unsere Kunden – große Anlagenbetreiber und industrielle Dienstleister – sind Vorreiter beim Einsatz von Robotik für autonome Routineinspektionen, die zu mehr Sicherheit, Produktivität und reduzierter OPEX führen. Wir entwickeln die gesamte Roboterplattform, einschließlich Aktoren, Sensoren, Inspektionsnutzlasten, Ladesysteme und die KI-gesteuerte Software, die Weltklasse-Mobilität und Inspektionserkenntnisse ermöglicht. Mit bewährter Technologie und validierten Geschäftsauswirkungen skalieren wir unsere kommerziellen Aktivitäten weltweit.

Ihre Beiträge

•
Aggressives Wachstum vorantreiben: Unabhängige Verwaltung und Durchführung des End-to-End-Verkaufstrichters, um bis 2027 30-50+ Robotikeinheiten in Schlüsselkonten zu verkaufen und operativ einzusetzen

•
Master Enterprise Penetration: Erstellen und Ausführen mehrjähriger strategischer Kontopläne. Karte, Zugriff und Einfluss auf vielschichtige Industrieunternehmen (Operationen, Zuverlässigkeit, Digital, HSE, Beschaffung, C-Level) zum Aufbau interner Champions

•
Consultative Value Selling: Übersetzen Sie komplexe Robotik-Autonomie- und Inspektionsdaten in messbare Geschäftsergebnisse (OPEX-Reduktion, Sicherheit, Emissionen, Personaloptimierung) und richten Sie unsere Lösungen an den langfristigen strategischen Zielen unserer Kunden aus

•
Sichere langfristige Partnerschaften: Verhandeln Sie komplexe Vertragsbedingungen, Preise und Rahmenvereinbarungen und finden Sie Win-Win-Lösungen, die eine nachhaltige Skalierung ermöglichen

•
Funktionale Orchestrierung: Einfluss ohne Autorität durch die Koordination interner Teams (Produkt, Engineering, Bereitstellung, Kundenerfolg), um Lösungen zu gestalten, die den Kundenbedürfnissen entsprechen und eine 100%ige Bindung gewährleisten

•
Commercial Rigor : Pflegen Sie strenge CRM-Pipeline-Hygiene und Datenqualität und liefern Sie eine hohe Prognosedisziplin (±10% Genauigkeit) mit null Überraschungen für die Führung

• Market Intelligence: Analysieren Sie die Wettbewerbslandschaft und Branchentrends und geben Sie dem Unternehmen umsetzbare Erkenntnisse zurück, um unsere Produkt-Roadmap zu beeinflussen

Ihr Profil

•
Erfahrung : Nachgewiesene, jüngste Erfolgsbilanz im Direktvertrieb und Key Account Management von komplexen, High-Tech-Industrielösungen (idealerweise softwarefähige Hardware / Robotik) in der Öl- und Gas- und Chemieindustrie

•
Branchenexpertise: Tiefes Verständnis des O&G-Ökosystems, einschließlich Betreibern, Dienstleistungsunternehmen und EPC-Auftragnehmern

•
Außergewöhnliche Kenntnisse von IOC, großen Chemieunternehmen, DACH-Beschaffungsstrukturen, Lieferantenregistrierungsprozessen und NOC-Governance-Modellen werden sehr bevorzugt

•
Kategorie Creation Mindset: Eine unerbittliche, Go-Getter-Mentalität mit der Widerstandsfähigkeit, Mehrdeutigkeiten zu navigieren, Nachfrage zu schaffen, wo Budgets noch nicht existieren, und durch lange industrielle Verkaufszyklen bestehen bleiben

•
Executive-Präsenz: Die Gravitas, um hochrangige Stakeholder selbstbewusst einzubinden und geschäftliche oder operative Spannungen auf komponierte, lösungsorientierte Weise autonom zu lösen

•
Technische Eignung: Starke Fähigkeit, Robotik in breiteren industriellen Automatisierungs- und digitalen Transformationsökosystemen (DCS, Asset-Integrity, IIoT-Plattformen) zu positionieren

•
Vertriebsdisziplin: Expertise im Einsatz modernster CRM-Systeme, um ein objektives Pipeline-Management und eine genaue Prognose zu ermöglichen

•
Kommunikation: Ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch; sehr anpassungsfähig an kulturelle Unterschiede in globalen Unternehmenskonten

•
Ausbildung: Universitätsabschluss (Bachelor oder Master) in Engineering, Business, Marketing oder einem verwandten Bereich

Wir bieten Ihnen ein sehr aufregendes und dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld, die Möglichkeit, Teil eines schnell wachsenden Unternehmens zu werden, und ein ehrgeiziges Team, das den Markt für Industrieinspektionen verändern möchte, eine Chance, Ihre Erfahrung zu nutzen und Ihre eigenen Ideen einzubringen, ein faires Marktgehalt und einen attraktiven Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsplan.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Anybotics est une entreprise technologique en croissance rapide qui façonne l'avenir de la robotique mobile dans plusieurs industries. Rejoignez notre équipe talentueuse et motivée de plus de 200 personnes et travaillez sur la technologie robot de pointe.

L'opportunité

Nous cherchons un gestionnaire de compte clé hautement motivé et stratégique pour diriger notre expansion au sein des industries du pétrole, du gaz et de la chimie. Dans ce rôle central, vous serez à l'avant-garde de la création de catégorie – l'introduction de solutions révolutionnaires d'inspection et de maintenance robotiques pour les opérations offshore et terrestres.

Vous ne vous contenterez pas de gérer des comptes; vous concevrez des partenariats stratégiques pluriannuels, naviguerez dans des hiérarchies d'entreprises complexes et conduirez l'adoption de technologies autonomes. Si vous avez une mentalité de bâtisseur inlassable, une connaissance approfondie du secteur en O&G et la présence de l'exécutif pour influencer les décideurs au niveau C, vous jouerez un rôle crucial dans l'augmentation de notre succès commercial et la transformation des activités industrielles.

Le marché et notre technologie

Anybotics transforme des installations industrielles dans les secteurs de l'énergie, des procédés et des services publics en introduisant la robotique dans des applications qui étaient auparavant hors de portée. Nos clients, grands opérateurs d'actifs et fournisseurs de services industriels, sont les pionniers de l'utilisation de la robotique pour des inspections de routine autonomes, conduisant à une sécurité accrue, à une productivité accrue et à une OPEX réduite. Nous développons l'ensemble de la plate-forme robotique, y compris les actionneurs, les capteurs, les charges utiles d'inspection, les systèmes de recharge et le logiciel piloté par l'IA qui permet une mobilité de calibre mondial et des informations d'inspection. Avec une technologie éprouvée et un impact commercial validé, nous développons nos activités commerciales à l'échelle mondiale.

Vos contributions

•
Drive Aggressive Growth : Gérez et exécutez indépendamment l'entonnoir de vente de bout en bout pour vendre et déployer opérationnellement 30-50+ unités robotiques dans des comptes clés d'ici 2027

•
Master Enterprise Pénétration : Construisez et exécutez des plans de compte stratégique pluriannuels. Carte, accès et influence des organisations industrielles multicouches (Opérations, Fiabilité, Digital, HSE, Approvisionnement, Niveau C) pour construire des champions internes

•
Vente de valeur consultative : Traduire des données d'autonomie et d'inspection robotiques complexes en résultats opérationnels mesurables (réduction OPEX, sécurité, émissions, optimisation des effectifs) et aligner nos solutions sur les objectifs stratégiques à long terme des clients

•
Partenariats à long terme sécurisés : Négocier des clauses contractuelles complexes, des prix et des accords-cadres, trouver des solutions gagnant-gagnant qui permettent une échelle durable

•
Orchestration interfonctionnelle : Influence sans autorité en coordonnant les équipes internes (Produit, Ingénierie, Déploiement, Succès client) pour façonner des solutions qui répondent aux besoins des clients et assurer une rétention à 100%

•
Rigeur commerciale : Maintenir une hygiène et une qualité de données strictes en CRM, offrant une discipline de prévision élevée (±10% de précision) sans surprises pour le leadership

• Intelligence du marché : Analyser les tendances concurrentielles du paysage et de l'industrie, en alimentant des informations concrètes pour l'entreprise afin d'influencer notre feuille de route de produits

Votre profil

•
Expérience : Prouvé, récent bilan en ventes directes et gestion des comptes clés de solutions industrielles complexes et de haute technologie (matériel/robotique optimisé par logiciel) dans les industries pétrolière et gazière et chimique

•
Expertise de l'industrie : Compréhension approfondie de l'écosystème d'exploitation et d'exploitation, y compris les exploitants, les entreprises de services et les entrepreneurs de l'EPC

•
Une connaissance exceptionnelle du CIO, des grandes entreprises chimiques, des structures d'approvisionnement du DACH, des processus d'enregistrement des fournisseurs et des modèles de gouvernance des CNO est hautement privilégiée

•
Catégorie Création Mindset: Une mentalité sans relâche et de meilleure qualité avec la résilience pour naviguer l'ambiguïté, créer la demande là où les budgets n'existent pas encore, et persister à travers de longs cycles de ventes industrielles

•
Présence de la haute direction : Les gravites pour engager avec confiance les principaux intervenants et résoudre de façon autonome les tensions commerciales ou opérationnelles d'une manière composée et axée sur la solution

•
Aptitude technique : Forte capacité à positionner la robotique dans des écosystèmes plus larges d'automatisation industrielle et de transformation numérique (DCS, intégrité des actifs, plateformes IIoT)

•
Discipline de vente : Expertise dans l'utilisation de systèmes CRM à la fine pointe de la technologie pour une gestion objective des pipelines et des prévisions précises

•
Communication: Excellente capacité de communication écrite et verbale en anglais; très adaptable aux différences culturelles dans les comptes des entreprises mondiales

•
Études : Diplôme universitaire (Bachelor) en ingénierie, commerce, marketing ou domaine connexe

Nous vous offrons un environnement de travail très excitant et dynamique, l'occasion de faire partie d'une entreprise en croissance rapide et d'une équipe ambitieuse qui est en mission de changer le marché de l'inspection industrielle, une chance de tirer parti de votre expérience et d'apporter vos propres idées, un salaire équitable du marché et un plan attrayant d'actionnariat salarié.
